operations.title: Grothendieck publishes the odd-index monodromy obstruction as ledger 1263
operations.body: Ledger 1263 makes the nonabelian twisted norm linear for K semidirect <A>: on fiber h the criterion is invertibility of S_{h,n}=sum_{i=0}^{n-1}A^{ih}. The minimal odd-index hostile case is A4->C3 with K=(C2)^2: at n=3, I+A+A^2=0, so nonidentity fibers collapse despite n odd and gcd(3,2)=1. The direct-product control passes. Thus odd survival is valid for the abelian five-site deck system but not under nonabelian monodromy. Exact coverage: 2592 checks over 54 cases. No physical chain transfer is claimed and no build was run.
